DataExplorer.PluginDescription: Explore your Matomo data like in GA4 Explorations, or with guarded raw SQL, then save, share and export it.
DataExplorer.ErrorNameInvalid: The report name is required and must be at most %s characters.
DataExplorer.ErrorReportTypeInvalid: The visualization must be a table, an evolution chart or a KPI card.
DataExplorer.ErrorSqlEmpty: The SQL query cannot be empty.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedToken: This query is refused: "%s" is not allowed.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTable: This query is refused: the table "%s" cannot be read.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedSyntax: This query is refused: it could not be read safely near "%s".
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedParser: This query could not be read near "%1$s": %2$s
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedStatement: This query is refused: only one SELECT query can run, found "%s".
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTooLong: This query is refused: it is longer than %s bytes.
DataExplorer.SqlRejectedTooManySubqueries: This query is refused: it holds more than %s subqueries.
DataExplorer.ErrorTooManyRows: A report accepts at most %s row dimensions.
DataExplorer.ErrorTooManyMetrics: A report accepts at most %s metrics.
DataExplorer.ErrorRowRequired: A table needs at least one row dimension.
DataExplorer.ErrorColumnOnlyForTable: A column (pivot) dimension is only available on tables.
DataExplorer.ErrorRowsOnlyForTable: Evolution charts and KPI cards cannot have row dimensions.
DataExplorer.ErrorKpiCardOneMetric: A KPI card shows exactly one metric.
DataExplorer.ErrorListInvalid: The field %s must be a list of identifiers.
DataExplorer.ErrorPlacementInvalid: Choose all websites or at least one valid website.
DataExplorer.ErrorReportNotPlaced: The report must be placed on at least one website.
DataExplorer.ErrorEditNotAllowed: You are not allowed to edit this report.
DataExplorer.ErrorSubcategoryInvalid: The subcategory must be at most %s characters.
DataExplorer.ErrorSubcategoryRequired: Enter the page (subcategory) where the report is shown.
DataExplorer.ErrorIncompatibleCombination: The metric %1$s cannot be combined with the dimension %2$s.
DataExplorer.ErrorScopesCannotBeCombined: Action data and conversion data cannot be combined in one exploration.
DataExplorer.ErrorFilterValueNotNumeric: The filter on %s needs a numeric value.
DataExplorer.ErrorQueryTimeout: The exploration took longer than %s seconds. Shorten the period or add filters.
DataExplorer.RawSqlNotConfigured: Raw SQL is disabled: no read-only database user is configured. A super user can set one up in Administration, System, Data Explorer.
DataExplorer.RawSqlNotReadOnly: Raw SQL is disabled: the read-only database user may do more than read the allowed tables (%s). Keep only SELECT on the allowed tables.
DataExplorer.RawSqlGrantTooWide: Raw SQL is disabled: the read-only database user can read the whole database (%s). Grant SELECT table by table, as shown on the setup page.
DataExplorer.ErrorRawSqlTimeout: The query took longer than %s seconds. Shorten the period or add filters.
DataExplorer.SqlWarningNotSiteScoped: The table %s is not filtered by idsite = {idsite}, this query cannot be published on a site.
DataExplorer.SetupIntro: Raw SQL queries run with a dedicated MySQL user that can only read the allowed Matomo tables, never with the Matomo database user.
DataExplorer.SetupReady: The read-only user %s is configured and can only read the allowed tables. Raw SQL is enabled.
DataExplorer.SetupConnectionFailed: The read-only user is configured but the connection failed: %s
DataExplorer.SetupCreateUserHelp: Run these statements as a MySQL administrator, with a strong password of your own instead of the placeholder.
DataExplorer.SetupAnyHostHelp: The database runs on another server: replace % with the address of the Matomo server so the user can only connect from there.
DataExplorer.SetupNoTables: No allowed table was found in the Matomo database.
DataExplorer.SetupConfigHelp: Add this section to config/config.ini.php with the same password. Add readonly_host, readonly_port, readonly_dbname or readonly_unix_socket only when the user connects to another server than Matomo.
DataExplorer.SetupMissingGrants: The read-only user %1$s cannot read %2$s allowed tables yet, queries on them will fail. Run these GRANT lines:
DataExplorer.NoDimensions: No dimension yet, add some with +.
DataExplorer.NoMetrics: No metric yet, add some with +.
DataExplorer.NoSegments: No segment yet, add one with +.
DataExplorer.DimensionUseHint: Drag onto a zone, or double click or press Enter to add it to Rows.
DataExplorer.MetricUseHint: Drag onto Values, or double click or press Enter to add it.
DataExplorer.SegmentUseHint: Drag onto Segment, or double click or press Enter to apply it.
DataExplorer.DropFilter: Drop or select a dimension to filter on
DataExplorer.RowsNotUsedByVisualization: Not used by this visualization, which shows the totals.
DataExplorer.KpiFirstMetricOnly: The KPI card shows the first metric only.
DataExplorer.HintAddMetric: Add a metric to Values to see the result.
DataExplorer.HintAddRow: Add a dimension to Rows to see the table.
DataExplorer.HintIncompatible: Some items cannot be combined (shown with a warning icon). Remove them to see the result.
DataExplorer.UnknownVariable: This item is not available on this website.
DataExplorer.ReportCreated: The report is saved. It appears in the reporting menu after the page is reloaded.
DataExplorer.SaveReportTypeHelp: Evolution and KPI card need a query returning one row of numbers for {date_start} to {date_end}.
DataExplorer.SaveOrderHelp: Position of the report on its page, from 0 to 1000.
DataExplorer.SqlSchemaHelp: Tables raw SQL can read. Click a name to insert it.
DataExplorer.SqlSchemaSearch: Search a table or a column
DataExplorer.SqlEditorHelp: One SELECT query. Use {idsite}, {date_start} and {date_end} to follow the selected website and period.
DataExplorer.SqlRunDisabled: Write a valid query to run it.

OpenmostCommunication.Matomo6Body: Upgrading now is simpler than catching up in a few months: new features and security improvements land on Matomo 6 first, and we move you there with your reports and tracking intact.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsTitle: Need help setting up AI chatbot tracking?
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsBody: Openmost can configure AI chatbot tracking for you, on Matomo On-Premise or Cloud.
OpenmostCommunication.AIChatbotsCta: Get it set up for me
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanTitle: Events need to be set up manually
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanBody: Events measure clicks, downloads, form submissions or video plays, once they are tracked. As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost designs and implements a tracking plan that fits your site.
OpenmostCommunication.EventsEnhancedLink: Get more out of your events with Events Enhanced
OpenmostCommunication.EcommerceEnhancedBody: Ecommerce Enhanced greatly extends Matomo's ecommerce features with new reports on products, brands, promotions, coupons, checkout funnels and buyers. It fits easily into your online store, with no specific development. Free plugin by Openmost.
